provenance: deterministic assistant-authored finite Boolean mechanism experiment
candidate_formula: Y=B(U,G) XOR ((SIGNAL XOR U) AND H(U,G))
mask_rule: bit i of H is its Boolean value at background_order_U_G[i]
baseline_rule: B(U,G) equals the first v0.17 family model observed Y for that context
scope: All 16 Boolean off-support completions of the first model observed response on the fixed two-bit U,G domain, not all SCMs or real-world causal models.
selection_rule: Enumerate masks ascending. For existing nonvacuous stability claims, select the first model that violates the original family invariant.
